(loop
  (while (> (needs-any) 0)
    (let ((color red))
      (cond ((and (> (needs red) 0) (>= (needs red) (needs blue))) (set! color red))
            ((> (needs blue) 0) (set! color blue))
            (else (set! color red)))
      (while (< (count PACK color) 3)
        (move BELT)
        (if (> (count BELT color) 0)
            (begin (pick-up color) (move PACK) (put-down))
            (wait 1)))
      (move PACK)
      (pack color)
      (pick-up-box)
      (move DOCK)
      (put-down))))
